about: SDK 3.0.0 manifest vectors (make_manifest_vectors.py, reference manifest30.py). Each case: `manifest` is the exact text of a manifest.json (UTF-8), `sha256` its SHA-256, `config` the model entry of the signed config or null when a folder is opened without one, `expect` what SDK 3.0.0 does with it when it trusts only `public_key_hex`. Accepted cases also give `signed_text`, the text the signature verified on. The listed files do not exist. `real_manifests` are the two production manifests of V4 (in manifest_vectors/ of this repository): their signatures verify with the production key and 3.0 refuses both, because a 2.x build has no version.
checks_in_order: config given: the SHA-256 of the manifest bytes starts with the build the config named, else checksum_mismatch
the bytes are a JSON object of the format 3 shape; `version` (when present) and `min_sdk_version` are versions, else model_invalid
the signature verifies with a trusted key (up to four texts, README), else signature_invalid
min_sdk_version is not above the SDK's version, else model_incompatible
config given: the manifest's version is the version the config named, else model_invalid

cases.name: tampered version
cases.about: Signed as 4.0.0, then the field was changed to 4.0.1.

cases.name: tampered tolerance value
cases.about: Signed with lp_p99 1.5 for coreml log_probs, then changed to 2.5: no text verifies (the signature covers the lines, so the text without them is not the signed one either).

cases.name: tampered token_edits
cases.about: Signed with token_edits 0 for the NPU build, then changed to 3.

cases.name: tolerance entry removed after signing
cases.about: A signed build entry was deleted from the JSON.

cases.name: tampered file line
cases.about: A file's size was changed after signing.

cases.name: malformed tolerance entries
cases.about: Entries that are not well formed have no signed line and no tolerance: each build named bad-* is judged on tokens only, the others keep their tolerance. The publisher signs exactly the lines of the well-formed entries, so the signature still covers the field.

cases.name: no version
cases.about: A correctly signed format 3 manifest without `version` (a 2.x build): 3.0 refuses it.

cases.name: no version, 2.x min SDK
cases.about: The same with min_sdk_version 2.0.1, as build 519235d0 has it.

cases.name: min_sdk_version 3.1.100
cases.about: The build needs a newer SDK than any 3.0.x or 3.1.x in use (compared part by part as integers: 3.1.100 is above 3.1.9, 10.0.0 is above 3.0.0).

cases.name: min_sdk_version 3.2.0
cases.about: The build needs a newer SDK than any 3.0.x or 3.1.x in use (compared part by part as integers: 3.1.100 is above 3.1.9, 10.0.0 is above 3.0.0).

cases.name: min_sdk_version 10.0.0
cases.about: The build needs a newer SDK than any 3.0.x or 3.1.x in use (compared part by part as integers: 3.1.100 is above 3.1.9, 10.0.0 is above 3.0.0).

cases.name: min_sdk_version 2.0.1 with a version
cases.about: The SDK only checks that min_sdk_version is not above its own version; it does not refuse a version line with a lower min SDK (the CDN refuses that build at upload).
